scope: Scope follows the attached chart's coverage (strong verb across 7 binyanim, then Peh-Nun, Peh-Guttural, Lamed-Guttural, Lamed-Alef, Lamed-Yod, Peh-Yod, Ayin-Vav/Yod, Ayin-Ayin). Teaching roots for L8+ are proposals only.

checkMix.note: A pre-lesson check draws about 70% of items from the student's current level and 30% review from earlier levels; missed cells come back sooner (see SPEC.md).

itemTypes.parse: Show a real verse form (only cells whose status is attested-example, using exampleWord + exampleRef). Student picks binyan, conjugation, PGN.
itemTypes.fillCell: Hide one cell of the קטל table and ask for it. Any cell can be used, including paradigm-standard ones.
